findings.evidence: Previously the fallback reused the primary URL and key (both OpenRouter); with the primary retargeted to api.voyageai.com, the Cohere fallback works only if the reranker client reads BRAIN_RERANK_FALLBACK_URL and BRAIN_RERANK_FALLBACK_API_KEY_FILE rather than deriving from BRAIN_RERANKER_URL/BRAIN_R
findings.title: Fallback correctness depends on runtime consuming the new fallback vars

findings.evidence: The fallback keeps per-request data_collection deny, but the voyage primary carries no equivalent in config; compliance with ruling d4648d84 Q4 rests on the training opt-out enabled on the operator's Voyage account (decision 7d36a08c), which the diff cannot verify. Confirm the account setting is act
findings.title: Primary data policy is account-level, not config-enforced

findings.evidence: The diff removes BRAIN_RERANK_HEALTH_PATH (/v1/key, the OpenRouter key check) and no test asserts a probe path or rerank_health_path, so if the voyage backend's probe still resolves a path-based default instead of the described one-document POST, the post-deploy probe would fail against api.voyageai
findings.title: Dropped BRAIN_RERANK_HEALTH_PATH leaves the voyage probe unasserted
